Class IntradayDerivedDependencyUpdater

java.lang.Object
grafioschtrader.priceupdate.intraday.IntradayDerivedDependencyUpdater
public class IntradayDerivedDependencyUpdater extends Object
Updates the intraday prices of a list of securities so that every derived security is calculated after the instruments it is derived from.

A derived security takes its price from its main link and, with a formula, from further linked instruments. That calculation is only as current as the linked prices it reads, which leads to three requirements:

  • A linked instrument that is not part of the update list, for example the currency pair behind a derived security of a watchlist, is updated as well before the calculation. It is not part of the result.
  • Instruments the caller has refreshed before, such as the currency pairs of a watchlist or prices received from a GTNet peer, are not requested again and are used as they are; a GTNet price exists only on that instance.
  • A derived security built on another derived security is calculated after it. The securities are therefore calculated in dependency levels, each level in parallel.

Like the intraday loaders it uses, this class is created by SecurityJpaRepositoryImpl and is not a Spring bean; every write commits on its own through the repository proxies.

  • Method Details

    • updateLastPrices

      public List<Security> updateLastPrices(List<Security> securities, Collection<? extends Securitycurrency<?>> refreshedInstruments, boolean refreshMissingLinks, boolean singleThread)
      Updates the last prices of the given securities, the connector based ones first and then the derived ones in the order of their dependencies.
      Parameters:
      securities - the securities to update, derived or not
      refreshedInstruments - instruments the caller has already updated in this price update; they are neither requested again nor reloaded from the database
      refreshMissingLinks - true to load and update linked instruments that are neither in securities nor in refreshedInstruments. False when the caller has just updated every instrument anyway, as the periodic update of all prices does.
      singleThread - true to process every step on the calling thread
      Returns:
      the securities after their update: first the non-derived ones, then the derived ones, each in input order. Linked instruments that were updated additionally are not included.
